nl.title: LiteSpeed Cache voor WordPress activeren via CyberPanel / OpenLiteSpeed
nl.excerpt: LiteSpeed Cache voor WordPress activeren via CyberPanel / OpenLiteSpeed: praktische handleiding in CyberPanel, met stappen, controles en wanneer je TripleZero iT support inschakelt.
nl.bodyHtml:
LiteSpeed Cache (LSCache) werkt optimaal op OpenLiteSpeed/CyberPanel en versnelt WordPress sterk als correct geconfigureerd.

Activeren

  1. Installeer de LiteSpeed Cache-plugin in WordPress.
  2. Bevestig dat de server OLS/LSWS is (CyberPanel standaard).
  3. Schakel page cache in; start met defaults.
  4. Sluit winkelwagen/account-pagina’s uit indien WooCommerce.
  5. Purge cache na deploy.

Tip: Bij rare layout na login: cache-variaties / exclude logged-in users controleren.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem. Vermeld hostname, CyberPanel-URL en wat je precies ziet (foutmelding of screenshot).

Gerelateerd: OpenLiteSpeed basics; rewrite/htaccess.

en.title: Activate LiteSpeed ​​Cache for WordPress via CyberPanel / OpenLiteSpeed
en.excerpt: CDN/cache: correct zone, purge or rule, keep origin reachable, then test the live URL.
en.bodyHtml:
“Enable LiteSpeed Cache for WordPress via CyberPanel / OpenLiteSpeed”: changes in Cloudflare/CDN or server cache — always test the live URL and an optional bypass.

Preparation

  • CDN/panel login
  • Domain/zone
  • Whether SSL Full (strict) already works

Steps

  1. Open the correct Cloudflare zone or CDN panel for the domain.
  2. For cache issues: Purge Cache (selective or everything) after a content change.
  3. For performance: check caching level, HTTP/2/3, and page/Cache Rules.
  4. Keep origin (A/AAAA or CNAME) reachable; orange-cloud proxy only if origin SSL is valid.
  5. Test in a private window and optionally with a cache-bypass header or development mode.

Verify

  • New content visible
  • No SSL/loop errors

Tip: Exclude /cart /checkout /wp-admin from full-page CDN cache.

Note: Everything-purge at peak traffic can overload origin — prefer selective.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: SSL, DNS, WordPress cache.
